dct_title_s: Satellite-detected damage to cultural heritage in Min Kun as of 03 April 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20250328MMR, GDACS ID: 1474477** This map shows the locations where damage was detected based on a very high resolution satellite image collected 03 April 2025 when compared to very high resolution satellite imagery from 23 March 2025. The USGS shake map indicates the intentsity of the earthquake measured 8.0 - 8.5 in this area. Across the site 11 damaged cultural heritage locations were observed and an additional 3 have possible damage. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
